releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.174: The Calendar view entry remains removed from the Me menu only; Personal Calendar and saved calendar data are unchanged. Note Lock wrong-PIN feedback now appears inside the same PIN box without a separate alert or address/autofill suggestion. Existing PIN/recovery data and all saved notes, photos, documents, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
